Omar (eng): bench sketch: models rdx-small/rdx-medium; runs: calibration + 4h soak; metrics: p50/p95, GPU temp, OOMs; upload -> s3://eap-nimbus/<run>. I'll prep runbook.
Clara (hw-ops): I'll create presigned bucket and share creds privately.
Vik (legal): NDA sent 3210001125, please escalate redlines within 48h.
Lena (partnerships): Action items: @Vik NDA; @Clara presigned bucket + creds; @Omar runbook + smoke test. Hold any press until mutual signoff. Closing thread for now.
